rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: The Detail That Makes It Official
card.instruction: Choose one tiny procedural detail—wording, order, timing, seating, or a mark—and treat it as the only source of legitimacy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This marriage certificate has the dot above the wrong letter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've been married twenty years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Socially, certainly. Typographically, it's complicated.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We have three children.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let's correct it before they inherit the error.

card.title: The Detail That Makes It Official
card.instruction: Choose one tiny procedural detail—wording, order, timing, seating, or a mark—and treat it as the only source of legitimacy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your club resignation has the seal upside down. You're still our secretary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've moved abroad. Rotate the page.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There. Now your resignation is valid.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Good. You can stop sending me the minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll rotate the previous eleven too. We may owe you a year's subscriptions.

card.title: Everything Is Policy
card.instruction: Treat every personal choice as evidence of a larger system. Connect exceptions, habits, and coincidences until they become institutional doctrine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You sat beside me at lunch. Shall I record that as our friendship policy?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was the only empty chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So friendship is allocated by availability. Useful clarification.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow I'll save you a seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We've moved from allocation to a reserved entitlement.

card.title: Everything Is Policy
card.instruction: Treat every personal choice as evidence of a larger system. Connect exceptions, habits, and coincidences until they become institutional doctrine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You apologised before making tea. Is that our conflict-resolution procedure now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I knocked over your cup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So material damage triggers refreshments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yesterday I made tea because you looked sad. Nothing broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sadness qualifies as damage. I'll amend the procedure before either of us has to smash anything.

card.title: Winner Sets the Terms
card.instruction: Carry yourself as though success gives you the right to define the next challenge, the reward, and what counts as fair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I won the bake-off, so next year's theme is cakes I already make.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You beat my lemon cake by half a point.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then lemon cakes clearly get a fair chance under my leadership.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'll enter that same cake again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Returning challengers must improve by a full point. The champion sets the standard.

card.title: Winner Sets the Terms
card.instruction: Carry yourself as though success gives you the right to define the next challenge, the reward, and what counts as fair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As winner of family bowling, I choose where we eat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We only agreed you'd get a trophy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A trophy recognises judgement under pressure. Mine says pizza.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your brother can't eat cheese.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the next event is finding pizza he can eat. I'll award myself the biggest slice for organising it.

card.title: One Loss from Irrelevance
card.instruction: Project confidence while treating every setback as proof your standing could vanish. Regain control by raising the importance of the next result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That lost chess game was practice. This rematch will establish my reputation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've played here for thirty years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I won't have thirty years remembered for one dropped rook.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just came for tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll make it. One excellent pot and you'll remember why you keep coming back.

card.title: One Loss from Irrelevance
card.instruction: Project confidence while treating every setback as proof your standing could vanish. Regain control by raising the importance of the next result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ignore my terrible karaoke score. The next song determines whether I still have it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody doubted you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. One flawless song will keep it that way.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The machine's been unplugged.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we finally have a chance to judge the voice itself.

card.title: Official Scorer
card.instruction: Treat standards, margins, and fine distinctions as your craft. Correct how success is measured before allowing anyone to claim it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't claim longest scarf until we've measured without stretching it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's obviously longer than yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you won't mind laying both flat against this tape.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours only reaches because of the tassels.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quite right. Separate fringe measurements. I may have to surrender overall length and retain decorative reach.

card.title: Official Scorer
card.instruction: Treat standards, margins, and fine distinctions as your craft. Correct how success is measured before allowing anyone to claim it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The cake got nine out of ten for taste. What's the denominator for presentation?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone loved it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Love isn't scored consistently between judges.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've eaten the evidence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then 'most thoroughly consumed' is the only category I can certify.

card.title: I Earn My Seat
card.instruction: Behave as though belonging must be justified through performance. Make your competence visible whenever your right to participate feels uncertain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you ask who invited me to the committee, I've balanced its accounts.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You still need a membership vote.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you circulate the accounts with my application? Especially the savings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't vote tonight. Nobody's taken the minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I have. Alphabetised, with action points. Shall I read the section where you need a treasurer?

card.title: I Earn My Seat
card.instruction: Behave as though belonging must be justified through performance. Make your competence visible whenever your right to participate feels uncertain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've repaired the stage lights. Is there room for me in the theatre group now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can just come to a rehearsal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll learn everyone's lines first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't have to audition for the audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll time my laughs so nobody loses a line. You'll want me in the front row.

card.title: I Taught You to Compete
card.instruction: Treat every capable move around you as evidence that your coaching worked. Praise the result while claiming seniority over the method.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely winning serve. My drills finally paid off.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've never trained with you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You watched me practise. Observation is powerful teaching.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I copied the person who beat you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my defeat provided the lesson. You're welcome.

card.title: I Taught You to Compete
card.instruction: Treat every capable move around you as evidence that your coaching worked. Praise the result while claiming seniority over the method.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You negotiated a brilliant discount on that sofa. That's my influence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You told me to pay full price.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I was provoking independent judgement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Next time I'll leave you at home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You're ready for unsupervised work. Ring me afterwards for your assessment.

card.title: Keeper of the Stakes
card.instruction: Remain understated while controlling the reward, penalty, deadline, or condition that determines what winning actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on winning the raffle. The prize is this hamper, once you've returned the basket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need the basket to carry everything home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can borrow it until six. I'll keep the chocolates as a deposit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My bus doesn't get back until seven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Seven is fine. I'll need the wine as well.

card.title: Keeper of the Stakes
card.instruction: Remain understated while controlling the reward, penalty, deadline, or condition that determines what winning actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've won the office parking space. I hold the allocation calendar.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I park there tomorrow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Your free hour starts at six.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My shift starts at nine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can move you to nine on Sunday. You'll have the whole office to yourself.

card.title: We Learned to Win Together
card.instruction: Treat your memories of competing side by side as proof that you still understand one another better than anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember our relay signal? Two taps meant you needed me to take over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're racing against each other today. I just want a fair start.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said that before our county final. You needed a minute to breathe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My daughter thinks I'm nervous because she's watching.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She's missed the ankle bounce. That's your winning leg warming up. I've seen it bring us home.

card.title: We Learned to Win Together
card.instruction: Treat your memories of competing side by side as proof that you still understand one another better than anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use our old quiz-night look when one of us knows the answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're on different teams.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That never stopped us knowing who needed help.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My team would call that cheating.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They don't know our look well enough to judge it.

card.title: You Owe Me the Chance
card.instruction: Treat a past sacrifice, concession, or missed opportunity as a debt that should now be repaid with a real advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I withdrew from last year's audition for you. I get first choice of songs now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't ask you to withdraw.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I made the sacrifice easy to receive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thanked you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks covered last year. This year I'm collecting the opportunity.

card.title: You Owe Me the Chance
card.instruction: Treat a past sacrifice, concession, or missed opportunity as a debt that should now be repaid with a real advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You had the good room on our last holiday. I'm choosing this one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You said you liked the sofa bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I was generous in both room allocation and commentary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why didn't you say so?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I was saving the advantage for a holiday with a balcony.

transfer.action: I add one tiny validating dot beside {prop}.
transfer.response: In the wrong position, it only happens unofficially. {counter}
transfer.challenge: What difference can a dot make?
transfer.closing: The difference between an event and one the record permits us to recognize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your note says 'regretfully.' A valid clearing of the air begins with 'sorry.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry for what?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The opening word must be correct before we discuss its object.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add my name so I know which relationship your excellent beginning applies to.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A will accept an unspoken-offence apology only with one exact formal marker; the tiny wording feature becomes A's way to manoeuvre toward remorse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we enjoy tea, could you put a full stop after your apology?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't apologised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That explains why the sentence feels incomplete.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What sentence?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'I'm sorry' and we'll find the correct punctuation together.

card.title: Say You’re Sorry
card.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've bought a replacement mug. Not that anyone needs to say anything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did I break your mug?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Interesting that you started there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry about the mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep that tone. Think a little more recently.

card.title: The Detail That Makes It Official
card.instruction: Choose one tiny procedural detail—wording, order, timing, seating, or a mark—and treat it as the only source of legitimacy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You placed the club seal upside down. This isn't a valid resignation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already moved abroad.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Travel doesn't rotate a seal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can turn the page over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That makes it an internationally submitted resignation. Different form.

card.title: Say You’re Sorry
card.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely day for clearing the air, isn't it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are we opening a window?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Some things require more than ventilation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Have I upset you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's an excellent opening. I'd keep going.

transfer.action: I open Rules of Us beside {prop} and add a signature box.
transfer.response: A habit repeated twice becomes policy. {counter}
transfer.challenge: Do we need a rule for everything?
transfer.closing: Only the things we keep doing without admitting we've agreed how.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You always make tea after we argue. We can't close the reconciliation meeting with two full cups.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pour mine away. My taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're disposing of unfinished business. That has to go in the minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'll drink it in the taxi.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we're moving the reconciliation meeting. I'll get my coat.

bespokePairs.seedUse: Uses the post-argument tea becoming conflict-resolution doctrine in S192-single-b and the taxi leaving an argument unresolved in D74-single-b. Pouring tea away and transporting it are new B offers that A reclassifies as institutional acts to keep the reconciliation encounter going.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You always say 'see you tomorrow' before leaving. Does tonight's silence mean our argument changed the policy?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It means I'm tired. I've called a taxi.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then please say it. I need to know we're still on speaking terms.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: See you next Tuesday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a suspension, not a goodbye. Can we hold the appeal before your taxi gets here?

bespokePairs.seedUse: Uses ordinary behavior elevated to policy from S192-single-a/b and postponing departure until emotional repair from D74-single-b. The repeated goodbye is retained from the prior pair version; the postponed date is new pressure supplied by B.

card.title: Everything Is Policy
card.instruction: Treat every personal choice as evidence of a larger system. Connect exceptions, habits, and coincidences until they become institutional doctrine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You apologised before making tea. Is that our conflict-resolution procedure now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I knocked over your cup.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So material damage triggers refreshments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also felt bad.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll add remorse as an optional supporting document.

card.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
card.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't call the taxi yet. We haven't settled last night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We finished the conversation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We stopped talking. That's a different task.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're going to make us late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd rather arrive late than leave like this.

transfer.action: I put my winner's medal on the next rules beside {prop}.
transfer.response: Winning qualified me to define the next round. {counter}
transfer.closing: A sensible result of letting a qualified winner write them.

transfer.action: I hide the loss under a fresh challenge beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: That round was practice. This one matters. {request}
transfer.response: Give me another chance before deciding the chair is vacant. {counter}
transfer.closing: Not while I keep giving them a reason to watch.

transfer.action: I measure the disputed result beside {prop}.
transfer.response: An inch can be the whole outcome. {counter}
transfer.closing: Close is a measurement. Enough is the ruling you haven't justified.

transfer.action: I put my completed work beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: My place is right there in the result. {request}
transfer.response: Judge the work before asking who invited me. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then let the work apply on my behalf while I demonstrate the difficult part.

transfer.action: I circle the technique I claim to have taught beside {prop}.
transfer.response: That result has a foundation I remember supplying. {counter}
transfer.closing: Using the learning muscles my first lessons developed. A deeper success.

transfer.action: I keep the prize box closed beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Winning depends on what I put in here. {request}
transfer.response: We'll agree on my conditions before collecting anything. {counter}
transfer.closing: And now it needs the person who decides what the result is worth.

transfer.action: I set our old matching wristbands beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: We still know the same winning rhythm. {request}
transfer.response: Try the old double act for one more round. {counter}
transfer.closing: Our hands keep forgetting that when the difficult part arrives.

transfer.action: I put my old withdrawn entry beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I stepped aside. It bought me a turn. {request}
transfer.response: This is the space where my opportunity used to be. {counter}
transfer.closing: Yes. I'm asking generosity to remember who was waiting next.
